note: Changes that are finished but are waiting for the next card update, because sending one costs a signed update to every card in a customer's home. Run "npm run firmware:waiting" to read this, and "npm run firmware:release" to carry it all at once.

waiting.what: The card page's blackout button now labels itself Lights on/off (and keeps aria-pressed in sync), and Edit in Studio hands the open Studio tab a message instead of reloading it (bridge v7).
waiting.why: Bench/USB-only label and messaging fix with no wiring, safety, or protocol-breaking change — doesn't need a customer-facing signed release on its own.
